text.p: Following are some of the main stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Finance Ministry's capital markets agency will convert all Dutch government debt into euros as soon as European economic and monetary union begins on January 1, 1999. (p1)
- Finance Minister Gerrit Zalm says Netherlands should aim to reduce its budget deficit to zero under the new government which takes office after elections in May 1998. (p1)
- Unilever plans rapid expansion in Russia and is in talks to acquire a margarine factory there. p25)
- Chemicals group DSM plans campaign to reverse declining interest of Dutch private investors in the company's shares. (p 11).
- Philips still at loggerheads with Grundig over its plans to cut back its ties with the loss-making German consumer electronics group. (p11)
